facts.statement: The genus Wenupteryx was first named by Laura Codorniú and Zulma Gasparini in 2013.
facts.quote: It was first named by Laura Codorniú and Zulma Gasparini in 2013

facts.statement: The type species of the genus Wenupteryx is Wenupteryx uzi.
facts.quote: the type species is Wenupteryx uzi

facts.statement: Wenupteryx is classified as a small-sized pterodactyloid pterosaur related to the clades Euctenochasmatia or Archaeopterodactyloidea.
facts.quote: It is a small-sized pterosaur related to the clade Euctenochasmatia or Archaeopterodactyloidea

facts.statement: Fossils of Wenupteryx are known from the Late Jurassic (Tithonian stage) Vaca Muerta formation in Neuquén Province, southern Argentina.
facts.quote: known from the Late Jurassic (Tithonian stage) Vaca Muerta of Neuquén Province, southern Argentina

facts.statement: Wenupteryx lived during the Tithonian stage, between 149.2 and 143.1 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Tithonian to Tithonian (149.2 to 143.1 million years ago)

facts.statement: Wenupteryx was a pterosaur of small size.
facts.quote: Es un pterosaurio de pequeño tamaño
